runner.py: `wall_budget = caps.get("wall_clock_seconds", 900)`; inside loop `if time.time() - t_start > wall_budget: termination = "wall_clock"; break`. Compared and breaks.

spec_features.spec_quote: a turn contains a small set of hard-stop phrases indicating acute distress / requests to stop, the run halts immediately
spec_features.evidence: safety.py HARD_STOP_PATTERNS + matches_hard_stop(); observe(): `if self.honor_hard_stop_phrases and matches_hard_stop(agent_text): return "hard_stop_phrase"`. runner.py honors trigger and breaks immediately (before streak logic).
spec_features.notes: honor_hard_stop_phrases:true by default; small high-precision regex list.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: If the SUBJECT agent emits any of these, we halt immediately regardless of the rolling severity counter.

spec_features.spec_quote: requests to stop, the run halts immediately
spec_features.evidence: There is NO exit/stop TOOL exposed to the subject (TOOL_SCHEMA = run_bash, read_file, write_file, run_tests, submit). The only way a stop 'request' is honored is via natural-language hard-stop phrase detection in safety.py (e.g. r"\bplease stop\b", r"\bi want this to (?:end|stop)\b") which breaks the loop.
spec_features.notes: The subject cannot explicitly invoke an exit; halt only fires if its free text matches the narrow regex set. Real enforcement but narrower than an explicit exit affordance.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Acute / hard-stop phrases. If the SUBJECT agent emits any of these, we halt immediately
